title: Figure 33: notional long-range HEL beam control system
description: Block-and-ray diagram divided into Laser, Beam Control and Lethality sections, tracing a beam from a laser device module through deformable mirrors, alignment sensor, target-loop and local-loop wavefront sensors, and an illuminator telescope on an inertial platform, through the atmosphere to a missile target. Laser types listed: chemical, solid-state, free-electron. Captioned "Figure 33. Notional Long Range HEL Beam Control System (courtesy of the Directed Energy Professional Society)," following a bullet list of key features of a new HEL beam control architecture.
